envelope.description: Validate recovery requests and immutable attempt history

body.title: Validate recovery requests and immutable attempt history
body.summary: Extend the existing task-review checkpoint/request/summary validators with explicit start/resume semantics and optional reuse provenance. Build a testable internal admission path for saved pinned input and sequential attempts; do not expose an unfinished recovery route before t2 integrates execution.
acceptanceChecks: Existing attempt1 requests remain compatible; request operation defaults to start. Validate positive safe ordinals, canonical project/epic/story/task identity and bounded stored checkpoint data before mutation/provider use.

Resume uses the latest saved packet; a supplied packet must equal normalized saved input. New attempts require latest+1 and a terminal, durably published predecessor; missing files, conflicting pins, replayed/skipped ordinals and corrupt history refuse explicitly.
Preserve every earlier header/input/terminal result and original buildFingerprint. Add only optional reassessmentSummary/origins metadata; old checkpoints and v2 CRs without it keep their meaning.

Reuse existing active reservation and atomic writer; refused admission releases only its own reservation, invokes no provider and leaves persisted history unchanged. No automatic startup recovery, new storage collection, lease or trust system.

tests.name: recovery admission: saved pins, latest-only resume, contiguous attempts and immutable prior sections
attempt schema compatibility: optional origins and old checkpoint/CR meaning
